{{Infobox auto}}
The '''cleaver''' is a knife-like sword with [[Slaughter]] I and Looting II, sold by the [[Cook|cook]]. Its internal name is "butcher knife". It deals {{Hp|6}} damage and has 1500 durability, but it shortens the wielder's reach by 1 block.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 4 cook sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref name="trade">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/butcher/4/butcher_knife.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
Its attack reach is 1 block shorter than normal. The tooltip gives an attack speed of 1.6, but the item's attributes set only attack damage and reach, so it attacks at the base speed of 4.<ref name="trade" /> It is repaired with iron ingots.
